name: Ali-Tegin
role: Karakhanid ruler of Transoxiana from 1020 to 1034
contribution: A Karakhanid ruler in Transoxiana from 1020 to 1034 with a brief interruption in 1024/25.

checks.lead: Ali ibn Hasan, also known as Harun Bughra Khan and better known as Ali-Tegin (also spelled Alitigin) was a Karakhanid ruler in Transoxiana from 1020 to 1034 with a brief interruption in 1024/25.
